title: Ordinary Human follow-up: preserve capacity state on rejected intake
outcome: A failed initial Human follow-up intake restores its pre-intake provider-capacity retry and pause-latch fields while preserving the existing delegation/runtime rollback owner.
acceptance: A deterministic initial commit failure during completed-child Human follow-up preserves the pre-intake capacity retry and reset-fence pause fields, original queue and immutable control intent, while existing delegation/runtime rollback remains intact.
Focused regressions and the repository-required independent reviews and exact-input gate validate the restored fields and once-only retry behavior.
